searchText: <@!340345049063882753> - I'm doing some discv5 testing and grabbed the first two teku mainnet bootnodes from here: https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-mainnet/blob/master/bootnodes.txt The first one has some strange behaviour, in that the first few buckets (256-252) appear to be empty, but there are some nodes in the lower buckets. This might indicate some issue in the code. And the second bootnode I think is offline, just FYI Thanks. Will look into this tomorrow. Both bootnodes are running but we may have screwed up and changed the ip or something. Yeah cool. The first one I tried seems to be responding, but it only gave me peers on lower distances, which is really odd. Wonder if this happens with you also I don’t have my laptop with me to check. There’s been some changes to discv5 to support besu I think - I doubt they’d cause issues but does mean I’m not familiar with the latest changes there personally. Could have been going wrong for ages though - discovery can be very forgiving of odd behaviour and still find peers Yeah for sure. It would be hard to find if it has existed for a while fyi, I see the same behaviour when testing from the nimbus implementation.
